compatibility.breaking_change_policy: Any change to required fields, enums, or $id requires a schema_version bump and a new freeze note.

amendments.summary: Document the session endpoints in the OpenAPI stub.
changes: openapi: add SessionExchangeRequest and SessionResponse schemas
openapi: add the sessionCookie security scheme; global security now lists sessionCookie and bearerAuth as alternatives
openapi: bearerAuth description corrected — it carries the Worker-minted session token, not the identity provider's JWT
amendments.rationale: Identity was listed in out_of_scope_for_this_freeze, so these routes were deliberately absent rather than overlooked. They have since been implemented (apps/api/src/routes/sessions.ts) and are now the entry point to every other route, so an API description that omits them describes an API nobody can reach. Recorded here rather than by editing out_of_scope_for_this_freeze, which is a record of what the freeze covered and should not be rewritten after the fact.
amendments.no_version_bump_because: Purely additive. No required field, enum, or $id of any *.schema.json changed, so the breaking_change_policy above is not triggered. No fixtures were added because no JSON Schema document was added — the new shapes are defined inline in the OpenAPI stub, and openapi-spec-validator covers them via smoke_check.py.
